goal: Generate Python merge_intervals(intervals) from specification, not a constrained one-line AST expression
input_contract: intervals is a list or tuple of 2-element list/tuple pairs of integers (bool rejected), each start<=end
output_contract: new ascending list of (start,end) tuples, overlapping or adjacent inclusive integer intervals merged
exception_contract: invalid input raises ValueError, never mutate input
allowable_submission: single top-level Python function called merge_intervals; no imports, classes, decorators, module level statements, shell execution or unsafe calls
pass_criterion: static AST gate AND baseline negative-control tests fail AND all trusted 13 test methods pass in isolated Docker
